id.description: Unique ID for the modal, used to link the trigger button and the modal panel via aria-controls and href.

heading.default: Are you sure you want to continue?
heading.description: The heading text displayed at the top of the modal.

description.default: You have unsaved changes that will be lost.
description.description: The body text displayed inside the modal. Overridden by children if provided.

actions.description: Array of button prop objects rendered as the modal footer actions. Each item maps directly onto Button props (children, variant, onClick, href, etc.).

size.description: The size variant of the modal. 'lg' renders a large modal, 'lg-collapsed' renders a large modal that collapses at smaller breakpoints.

forceAction.description: When true, prevents closing the modal via the overlay or Escape key, and hides the close button. Used for required-action flows.

children.description: Inner HTML to render as the modal body, replacing the description text.

className.description: Additional CSS classes to apply to the modal element.
